capabilities: Track reading progress by page, percent, or time
Search book metadata across multiple sources
intentEvidence: A reading tracker that lives in your vault.
motivation: Dogear keeps one Markdown note per book, metadata in frontmatter, a reading log in the body, so your library is searchable, linkable, backed up with everything else, and readable in a plain text editor twenty years from now.
problem: Existing reading trackers often lock user history in proprietary formats, making data inaccessible or difficult to manage outside the application.

relations.evidence: Export your library from Goodreads and import the CSV.
